topic: Điều gì xảy ra nếu bạn chạy marathon với cái bụng rỗng?
title: Chạy marathon mà không ăn gì
hook: Điều gì xảy ra nếu bạn chạy marathon với cái bụng rỗng?

ingredients.desc: a simple 2D runner: round head, big white eyes with black pupils, body and limbs drawn as thick white lines, short electric-blue headband
a fuel tank shaped like a tall battery with thick white outline and a vertical level bar inside

shots.vo: Điều gì xảy ra nếu bạn chạy marathon với cái bụng rỗng?
shots.subject: the round-headed runner with the blue headband

start_frame.desc: The round-headed runner with the blue headband mid-stride at full sprint, one foot in the air, a giant white brick wall filling the right edge of the frame

action.do: The runner sprints two strides and slams face-first into the wall, body squashing flat like rubber
The runner bounces backward, eyes spinning, legs wobbling

shots.subject: the round-headed runner with the blue headband

start_frame.desc: The round-headed runner with the blue headband standing at a white start line, patting a hollow empty stomach drawn as a dashed circle

action.do: The runner pats the hollow stomach twice and the dashed circle shakes
The runner shrugs, crouches and launches forward off the start line

shots.vo: Cơ thể chỉ cất sẵn chừng 2.000 kcal glycogen.
shots.subject: the round-headed runner with the battery-shaped fuel tank on the back
shots.accent_on: the full level bar inside the tank

start_frame.desc: The round-headed runner jogging in place in profile, a tall battery-shaped fuel tank strapped to the back, its level bar full to the top

action.do: The level bar inside the tank pulses brightly twice
The runner gives a thumbs-up and bounces on the toes with springy squash-and-stretch

shots.subject: the round-headed runner with the battery-shaped fuel tank on the back
shots.accent_on: the level bar inside the tank
shots.camera: Side tracking shot moving left to right with the runner

start_frame.desc: The round-headed runner running hard in profile from left to right, the tank on the back with its level bar full, small white flames licking from the tank top

action.do: The runner pumps arms and legs fast while the flames grow taller
The level bar drops sharply in two quick jerks

start_frame.desc: A small battery-shaped fuel tank on the left facing a huge white furnace mouth on the right

action.do: The furnace mouth gulps the level bar out of the tank in one big bite
The empty tank shivers while the furnace opens wide for more

shots.vo: Km 10: vẫn ổn, cơ bắp còn đầy năng lượng.
shots.subject: the round-headed runner with the battery-shaped fuel tank on the back
shots.accent_on: the level bar at three quarters

start_frame.desc: The round-headed runner running happily from left to right with a wide smile, the tank level bar at three quarters

action.do: The runner bounds forward with big springy strides, arms swinging high
The runner hops over a small white rock with an easy overshoot

shots.vo: Km 21: bình nhiên liệu vơi một nửa, chân bắt đầu nặng.
shots.subject: the round-headed runner with the battery-shaped fuel tank on the back

start_frame.desc: The round-headed runner running from left to right with sweat drops flying, the tank level bar at half

action.do: The runner strides on as sweat drops burst off the head
Each foot lands heavier, the body sagging lower with every step

shots.subject: the round-headed runner with the battery-shaped fuel tank on the back

action.do: The runner's legs swell into heavy grey blocks that drag and scrape along the ground

shots.subject: the battery-shaped fuel tank
shots.accent_on: the empty tank outline flashing alarm red

start_frame.desc: Close-up of the battery-shaped fuel tank, completely empty, its outline glowing alarm red

action.do: The empty tank flashes red three times and rattles violently

shots.vo: Và bạn đâm sầm vào thứ runner gọi là bức tường.
shots.subject: the round-headed runner with the blue headband

start_frame.desc: The round-headed runner staggering toward a giant white brick wall that fills the right half of the frame

end_frame.desc: The round-headed runner squashed flat against the giant white brick wall, arms spread wide, eyes spinning

action.do: The runner lurches forward and smashes into the wall, squashing flat on impact
The flattened runner peels slowly down the wall

shots.vo: Cơ thể buộc phải chuyển sang đốt mỡ, nhưng mỡ cháy quá chậm nên tốc độ tụt hẳn.
shots.subject: the round-headed runner with a big grey fat block on the back
shots.accent_on: the tiny flame under the fat block

start_frame.desc: The round-headed runner walking slowly with a big grey fat block strapped to the back, one tiny flame flickering under it

action.do: The tiny flame sputters and flickers while the runner trudges forward
The runner leans forward, exhausted, arms dangling

start_frame.desc: The round-headed runner crawling on hands and knees on the right, a small white snail with a shell on the left

action.do: The snail zips past the crawling runner leaving speed lines, the runner's jaw drops

shots.vo: Bất ngờ: runner chỉ 10% mỡ vẫn mang đủ năng lượng
shots.subject: the round-headed runner
shots.accent_on: the outline of the tower of fat blocks
shots.camera: Fast tilt up from the runner to the top of the tower

start_frame.desc: The small round-headed runner standing at the bottom of a towering stack of grey fat blocks rising out of the top of the frame

action.do: The tower of fat blocks shoots upward block by block with snappy overshoot
The runner looks up, eyes huge, mouth wide open

shots.subject: a long line of identical round-headed runners
shots.camera: Fast whip pan from left to right

start_frame.desc: A long diagonal line of identical tiny round-headed runners with blue headbands running from left to right

action.do: The line of runners sprints forward in perfect sync, legs blurring

shots.vo: Vấn đề không phải thiếu nhiên liệu, mà là đốt không kịp.
shots.subject: the huge fat block and the small battery-shaped fuel tank
shots.accent_on: the fast-flowing pipe from the fuel tank

start_frame.desc: A huge grey fat block on the left feeding a thin dripping pipe and a small battery-shaped fuel tank on the right feeding a wide gushing pipe, both pipes leading to a white engine in the center

action.do: The wide pipe gushes in fast pulses while the thin pipe releases one slow drip
The engine roars on the wide pipe and sputters on the thin one

shots.vo: Vì vậy runner nạp 30 đến 60 gram tinh bột mỗi giờ.
shots.subject: the round-headed runner with the blue headband
shots.camera: Side tracking shot moving left to right with the runner

start_frame.desc: The round-headed runner running from left to right, squeezing a small energy gel pouch into the mouth

action.do: The runner gulps the gel and the whole body flashes bright for an instant
The runner rockets forward with long smear lines, the headband flapping

outro.teaser: Uống quá nhiều nước khi chạy?

variants.scene: the round-headed runner with the blue headband sprinting with a terrified face, one stride away from smashing into a giant white brick wall
a tiny round-headed runner standing next to a towering stack of grey fat blocks
the round-headed runner running with a battery-shaped fuel tank on the back that is completely empty
the round-headed runner full of energy, smiling and sprinting

caption: Chạy 42 km mà không nạp gì thì cơ thể bạn sẽ ra sao? 🏃‍♂️⚡ Thí nghiệm #1
sources: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2958805 (Rapoport 2010, PLoS Comput Biol — glycogen ~2.000 kcal, 'bức tường' khi glycogen cạn)
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26891166 (AND/DC/ACSM 2016, Nutrition and Athletic Performance — 30–60 g carb/giờ)
https://www.scilit.com/publications/5386983805af95713111a6915b048ab7 (Margaria 1963, Energy cost of running — ~1 kcal/kg/km → 65 kg × 42,2 km ≈ 2.700 kcal)
Mỡ: 10% của 65 kg = 6,5 kg × ~7.700 kcal/kg ≈ 50.000 kcal ≈ 18 marathon (phép tính, làm tròn)
